title: California Insurance Code Section 10509.952 (which life policies the California illustration chapter covers)
updateCadence: Amended only by legislation. The section credit on the official host at the time of access read Added by Stats. 1996, Ch. 1106, Sec. 1. Effective January 1, 1997, with the section operative July 1, 1997 pursuant to Section 10509.965.
claims: Section 10509.952 provides that the life insurance illustrations chapter applies to all group and individual life insurance policies and certificates except variable life insurance, individual and group annuity contracts, credit life insurance, and life insurance policies with no illustrated death benefits on any individual exceeding ten thousand dollars.
notes: Section 10509.950, read at the same time, states that the chapter governs the regulation of life insurance policy illustrations and that the Legislature's intent is to ensure that illustrations do not mislead purchasers of life insurance and to make them more understandable. This record cites the California statute as enacted, not any model regulation it may resemble.
